q: The Denjoy-Koksma inequality for quasi-periodic functions gives a bound on the discrepancy of Birkhoff sums. For a function f of bounded variation Var(f) and the irrational rotation T_α with best approximations p_n/q_n:
opts: The sum equals ∫f for all n
The bound depends on α being Diophantine
exp: Denjoy-Koksma: |Σ_{k=0}^{qₙ-1} f(kα) − qₙ∫f| ≤ Var(f). This is a sharp bound for Birkhoff sums at the denominators qₙ of best rational approximations. It quantifies how well the irrational rotation approximates the time average by the space average.
